summary: Static review found two medium issues. Execution-dependent criteria remain unverified because checks were prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: Root package settings, workspace membership, committed lockfile, and Turborepo tasks.
checks.evidence: package.json:3 declares private, :4 pins pnpm@12.16.1, and :6 specifies 22.x. pnpm-workspace.yaml:2 includes packages/* and apps/*. The reviewed diff contains pnpm-lock.yaml; turbo.json:4 defines all four tasks. Matching the installed pnpm version requires execution, which was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Strict TypeScript settings, ESLint 9 flat configuration with typescript-eslint, and Vitest with locked versions.
checks.evidence: tsconfig.base.json:10 enables strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, and exactOptionalPropertyTypes. eslint.config.mjs:5 imports ESLint's flat-config helper and typescript-eslint. packages/schema/package.json:14 runs Vitest. pnpm-lock.yaml:175 and :194 pin the relevant dependencies.

checks.criterion: @terraluna/schema exports generated zod 4 schemas and inferred types for all three contracts.
checks.evidence: packages/schema/src/index.ts:3 exports all three schemas and types. Each generated module contains the required header. scripts/generate-zod.ts:438 requests zodVersion 4; package.json pins json-schema-to-zod 2.8.1. Regeneration, parsing, and the author's documentation-reading sequence were not independently verified.

checks.criterion: make schema regenerates both formats, and make schema-check detects drift in either output.
checks.evidence: Makefile:60 invokes both generators; :66 aggregates both drift-check exit statuses. packages/schema/scripts/generate-zod.ts:547 compares generated bytes and checks missing and extra modules. tests/generate-zod.test.ts:291 exercises output drift and :305 exercises changed JSON input. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Vitest tests precede implementation, exercise every shared case, and parse both mock files.
checks.evidence: Git file history shows tests added in f01ce0c0 before the generator in ea5cce12 and generated sources in 78cca543. packages/schema/tests/cases.test.ts:111 checks each case's verdict and preserves accepted values; mock-bundle.test.ts:15 parses both files. Runtime verdicts were not verified because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Makefile wires setup-ts, check-ts, and test-ts into setup, check, and test.
checks.evidence: Makefile:22 includes the TypeScript targets. setup-ts at :43 checks Node major 22 and invokes pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. check-ts at :51 runs lint/typecheck through Turborepo; test-ts at :54 dispatches the package's Vitest script. This is a static wiring assessment.

checks.criterion: Pinned commitlint and husky configuration is preserved, and frozen installation installs the commit-msg hook.
checks.evidence: package.json:9 preserves prepare=husky and :13 preserves commitlint 21.2.4 and husky 9.1.7. .husky/commit-msg:1 invokes commitlint. These settings are preserved in the diff, but hook installation requires the prohibited install command.

The scoped diff's 20 paths fall within the story's files list. config/run.yaml is unchanged. Generated validators use required nullable fields without coercion or defaults; cases.test.ts:120 checks that accepted values remain unchanged. Mock-file loading occurs in tests.

findings.claim: Require the Node minor version needed for bare TypeScript execution, or use a compatible runner. setup-ts accepts Node 22.17, but the schema commands and generator subprocess tests invoke a .ts file without enabling type stripping, so those commands fail on an accepted runtime.
findings.evidence: Makefile:44 accepts every 22.* version, while :16 invokes node packages/schema/scripts/generate-zod.ts. packages/schema/tests/generate-zod.test.ts:70 similarly spawns Node without flags. [Node 22 documentation](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/typescript.html) records that type stripping became enabled by default in 22.18.0. This conclusion is from static inspection; no command was executed.

findings.claim: Reject or faithfully translate combinations of enum/const with other string constraints. The supported-subset guard currently accepts combinations that the pinned converter silently weakens.
findings.evidence: The string branch permits enum together with minLength or pattern and returns without checking their interaction. In the installed pinned converter, dist/esm/parsers/parseSchema.js:97 selects parseEnum before parseString, and parseEnum.js:9 emits only the enum. Consequently, {"type":"string","enum":["","ok"],"minLength":1} is accepted by the guard but generates a validator accepting the forbidden empty string. Current committed schemas do not use this combination.
